**STATUS: FAIL.** Round 316 (PERF-7, self-hosting the web fonts) has one Medium bug, C-R316-01, sent to B. The other 13 checks pass, and every browser check ran (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true).

**The bug:** 4 of the 25 font files A copied in, all Playfair Display, are not the files a browser gets from Google today. The other 21 files are byte-identical.
- **Cause:** B's source fetch got Google's alternate `/l/font?kit=` versions of Playfair. I downloaded one of those links today and it matches the copied file exactly. A Chrome browser gets different `/s/…woff2` files.
- **Visible effect:** the Playfair heading "Curated Sound Collections" on `/store` differs from HEAD by 2,015 px at both 1440×900 and 1280×720. Two HEAD screenshots differ by 0 px, so this is not animation. The difference is in anti-aliasing only; text widths are equal at the weights in use (400–700).
- **Why Medium, not Low:** a Low would be deferred, so the round would publish checksums of the wrong files, and a test name, doc 229 and the licence notices that all say the files are byte-identical.
- **The fix is small:** replace the 4 files (already downloaded in `c-round-316/gfonts-dl/`) and update their 4 checksum lines. `fonts.css` and the doc and notice wording can stay as they are.

**What passes:**
- **File scope:** exactly 40 changed paths and protected files 11/11 OK, both unchanged from start to end. Claims and sketch equality also match.
- **Unit tests:** 236/236 on my own copy. B's 12 mutants give exactly B's results; A's notices mutant and my own (fonts section placed before LAME) both turn tests red.
- **Font requests (real browser, 3 fresh loads per page):**
  - 0 requests to Google and 0 render-blocking third-party files on `/`, `/store`, `/studio-lab` and `/studio/middle-east`.
  - The same fonts load as at HEAD, each file once, with no preload warnings.
  - `/studio-lab` downloads 69,732 font bytes, as specified.
- **Preloads and caching:** exactly the 2 font preloads on `/studio-lab`, none on other pages; font files are served as cached for a year (immutable).
- **Screenshots:** `/studio-lab` is 0 px different at both sizes.
- **Glyphs:** every text element uses the same fonts and glyph counts as HEAD.
- **First paint:**
  - `/` and `/store` paint 2 ms before and 0 ms after DOMContentLoaded (median; the limit is 150 ms).
  - `/studio-lab` paints no later than before: 260 vs 304 ms at 1440, 252 vs 268 ms at 1280.
  - `/studio-lab`'s gap after DOMContentLoaded is 199 ms at 1440 and 149 ms at 1280; that target belongs to PERF-11 and is reported only.
- **Perf spec, run alone:** passes; all 164 fixed rows equal round 315's.
- **Premium access:** not bypassed at either size. `/studio-lab` opens the demo with no user stored; `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio; the token endpoint returns 401 without credentials.

**Not proven:**
- The home-page screenshot row: the hero animates, so two HEAD screenshots already differ.
- Which character on `/studio-lab` triggers the Noto Sans Georgian download; no visible text uses it, and HEAD does the same.

Full test suite, build, Biome, verify and the e2e smoke belong to the root gate; I did not claim them. I edited no app source and committed nothing; the dev server at :5173 still serves the page, and my temporary servers are stopped.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-316.md
- c-round-316.json
- c-round-316/
